prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic cinematic luxury portrait of one original approved adult woman reclining on her side across a large rumpled bed in an opulent room.
prompt.main_subject: Original approved adult woman with long dark hair, calm confident direct gaze, natural warm skin texture, and relaxed languid body language. She wears a ruby-red reflective satin strapless evening gown with an elegant neckline and soft folds cascading over the bed, with one hand touching her hair.
composition_elements: Full-shot eye-level composition with the subject reclining on her side, one hand touching her hair and the other resting on the bedding.
Large rumpled bed with plush velvet and antique textiles, opulent decor, upholstered seating, and layered room detail.
Preserve ruby-red satin sheen, soft draping, direct gaze, and luxurious warm-versus-teal color contrast.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Dim natural window light with warm highlights on satin and skin, subtle teal undertones in the shadows, and soft ambient fill creating cinematic depth.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 4:5 full-shot portrait, 50mm lens at f/1.8, low ISO, restrained slow-shutter ambient feel, realistic satin, bedding, skin and room texture, subtle film grain, no text or watermark.
